name: Kandinsky 5.0 Video (Lite / Pro)
publisher: Kandinsky Lab (github.com/kandinskylab/kandinsky-5; HF kandinskylab; '(c) 2025 Kandinsky Lab'; Habr posts under the Sberbank account). ComfyUI native support contributed by Kijai (PR merged); companion files from Comfy-Org (Qwen2.5-VL), comfyanonymous (clip_l) and Kijai (HunyuanVideo VAE)

license.name: MIT
license.notes: GitHub LICENSE: 'The MIT License (MIT) Copyright (c) 2025 Kandinsky Lab'; every kandinskylab HF repo checked reports license: mit (Lite, Pro, LoRAs, WM). Commercial use unrestricted under MIT. Several web articles say 'Apache 2.0' - the repositories say MIT; use MIT. Third-party components in the Comfy graph carry their own licences: the HunyuanVideo 1.0 VAE (tencent-hunyuan-community), Qwen2.5-VL, CLIP-L.

cannot.what: more than 5 s with a 5 s checkpoint ('capable of generating videos up to 5 seconds long'); 10 s needs the _10s checkpoints (241 frames, width/height divisible by 128) - and there is no 10 s I2V Lite

Pro (19B) in practice on a 24-32 GB card: 43.4 GB bf16 single files, no official quantised Comfy file, no Comfy-Org template; community: 'exceeds 32GB VRAM and requires CPU offload, making it impractically slow' (single source). ComfyUI detects it (model_dim 4096) - a Pro recipe is pending
camera-control LoRAs in native ComfyUI: published as lora.safetensors per move (Arc / Dolly / Microwave / Truck) but ComfyUI compatibility is NOT FOUND (no template, no docs)
Kandinsky WM 1.0 (2026-08-04 Physical-AI I2V checkpoints) in ComfyUI: loadability NOT FOUND / untested
official prompting handbook: NOT FOUND (no prompting section in the README or the Comfy docs page)
native-ComfyUI VRAM figures: NOT FOUND; the publisher's own ComfyUI nodes ran 'at 24 GB with offloading', the reference pipeline 'on the GPUS with 12 GB' with NF4 Qwen

params.name: steps
params.meaning: sampling steps; NFE = steps x 2 at cfg > 1 (sft: 100 NFE), = steps at cfg 1

params.name: cfg
params.meaning: classifier-free guidance; at 1.0 ComfyUI skips the negative pass
params.interactions: 'CFG Scale: 1.0 for distilled16steps and nocfg, 5.0 for sft and pretrain models'; cfg 5 on a distilled file over-guides

params.name: shift ('Scheduler Scale')

official_reference_code.scheduler_scale: 10 in k5_lite_t2v_10s_sft_sd.yaml and k5_lite_i2v_5s_sft_sd.yaml; 5 in k5_lite_t2v_5s_distil_sd.yaml; pipeline default 10.0

params.interactions: DISAGREEMENT recorded: the Comfy I2V template uses 5, the publisher's README/config say 10 for I2V ('Scheduler Scale: 5.0 for 5s, 10.0 for 10s and image 2 video'); both dated late 2025. The i2v recipe ships the template's 5 and exposes the port - try 10 if motion/colour is off. The 10 s recipes use 10. The ModelSamplingSD3 node default 3.0 is wrong for Kandinsky

official_reference_code.sampler: NOT FOUND in the fetched sources

params.name: length
params.interactions: '768x512x121 for 5s or 768x512x241 for 10s'; the 5 s checkpoints are 'capable of generating videos up to 5 seconds long'

params.name: width / height
params.meaning: pixels; latent = /8 (HunyuanVideo 1.0 VAE); node step 16; the I2V template force-scales the start image to the same width x height (ImageScale lanczos, center crop)

defaults.I2V: 'aspect ratio of result is close to start image ratio and area is close to 768*512'

params.interactions: 10 s = NABLA sparse attention -> the 128 multiple

params.name: I2V start-frame fix
params.meaning: Kandinsky5ImageToVideo's 4th output cond_latent ('Clean encoded start images, used to replace the noisy start of the model output latents') replaces the sampled latent's frames at index 0, then NormalizeVideoLatentStart 'Normalizes the initial frames of a video latent to match the mean and standard deviation of subsequent reference frames'
params.interactions: dropping these brings back a visible seam at the start; remove NormalizeVideoLatentStart only if the start looks over-corrected (no official guidance)

defaults.reference pipeline negative_caption: Static, 2D cartoon, cartoon, 2d animation, paintings, images, worst quality, low quality, ugly, deformed, walking backwards

params.name: attention
params.meaning: the reference code offers Flash Attention 2/3, Sage, SDPA (--attention_engine) and NABLA for 10 s; ComfyUI uses its standard attention

rules.message: Kandinsky 5 video encodes text with DualCLIPLoader type 'kandinsky5' (Qwen2.5-VL 7B + CLIP-L); 'kandinsky5_image' is for Image Lite and 'hunyuan_video_15' for HunyuanVideo 1.5 - same Qwen file, different tokenizer
clip_name1 is Qwen2.5-VL 7B (qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled from the Comfy-Org HunyuanVideo 1.5 repack, template; or the full file)
clip_name2 is clip_l.safetensors (comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders)

every Kandinsky 5 video model decodes with the HunyuanVideo 1.0 VAE hunyuan_video_vae_bf16 (16-ch, 8x; ComfyUI latent_format HunyuanVideo) - NOT the HunyuanVideo 1.5 VAE hunyuanvideo15_vae_fp16 (32-ch, 16x), which does not match the latent
Kandinsky 5 frame counts are 4n+1 (latent = (length-1)//4+1; node step 4): 121 = 5 s @24 fps, 241 = 10 s
the 5 s checkpoints are 'capable of generating videos up to 5 seconds long' (121 frames @24 fps); 10 s needs the _10s checkpoints
the 10 s models are documented at 241 frames ('768x512x241 for 10s'); other lengths are untested here
Kandinsky5ImageToVideo takes width/height in multiples of 16 (and the I2V template scales the start image to the same size)
'Width and Height should be divisible by 128 for 10s model' (NABLA sparse attention): 768x512 qualifies, 848x480 does not
Lite was run at 768x512 by both templates ('area is close to 768*512'); other sizes are NOT FOUND for native ComfyUI (Pro HD is a 1280x768 class)
'CFG Scale: 1.0 for distilled16steps and nocfg' - cfg 5 on a distilled checkpoint over-guides
'5.0 for sft and pretrain models' (configs guidance_weight 5.0; both templates 5); other values are NOT FOUND
'Steps: 50, 16 for distilled version' - the distilled16steps model is a 16-NFE model
the publisher's configs run 50 steps for sft / pretrain / nocfg and I2V (templates: 50)
every Kandinsky 5 graph sets ModelSamplingSD3 shift 5 or 10 ('Scheduler Scale: 5.0 for 5s, 10.0 for 10s and image 2 video'; ComfyUI model default 10); the node default 3.0 is wrong for Kandinsky
the 10 s models use scheduler scale 10 (publisher README; k5_lite_t2v_10s_sft_sd.yaml scheduler_scale: 10)

I2V shift: the Comfy-Org template uses 5, the publisher's README and k5_lite_i2v_5s_sft_sd.yaml say 10 (also ComfyUI's model default) - both recorded; the recipe ships 5, try 10 if motion/colour is off
the I2V template puts the clean cond_latent (Kandinsky5ImageToVideo output 3) back at index 0 of the sampled latent with ReplaceVideoLatentFrames; without it the first frames show a seam
NormalizeVideoLatentStart (4 start frames vs 5 reference frames) follows the frame replacement in the template 'to reduce differences between the starting frames and the rest of the video'

the I2V template drives ImageScale and Kandinsky5ImageToVideo from the same Width/Height primitives (768x512, lanczos, center crop) - the start image must be exactly the latent size (the node bilinear-resizes otherwise, and the template's crop keeps the aspect honest)
a start image belongs with an _i2v_ checkpoint (the I2V template); the reverse works - 'Image2video checkpoint can work in text2video mode too' - but a T2V file with a start image is NOT FOUND
Kandinsky 5 video is 24 fps (templates; Pro HD description); another container fps changes playback speed

Pro (19B, 43.4 GB bf16) has no Comfy-Org template, no quantised Comfy file and no sub-H100 VRAM evidence (community: exceeds 32 GB without offload); ComfyUI detects it (model_dim 4096) but this profile cannot vouch for the graph
both templates need ComfyUI >= 0.4.0, below the pinned 0.35.0; nothing pending for version

prompting.negative_reference_pipeline: Static, 2D cartoon, cartoon, 2d animation, paintings, images, worst quality, low quality, ugly, deformed, walking backwards
prompting.negative_note: both Comfy templates ship an EMPTY negative; the reference pipeline's default negative_caption is quoted above - it only matters at cfg > 1 (sft / pretrain), never on the nocfg / distilled checkpoints

positive.line: Languages: 'generates videos from English and Russian prompts' - 'best understanding of Russian concepts in the open-source ecosystem'
Official prompting handbook: NOT FOUND (no prompting section in the README or the Comfy docs page); the pattern below is read from the official template prompts

Template pattern: comma-separated lighting / shot / composition / lens tags up front ('Rim light, side light, soft light, medium close-up, dusk, sunset, central composition, warm tones with low saturation, telephoto lens.'), then a prose description of subject, action, camera moves and atmosphere

I2V template (verbatim opening): 'Cinematic dynamic scene in deep blue dream haze: The camera glides slowly forward, focusing on tightly closed crystal flower buds ... As the lens pans right ... The camera then pulls back softly ...' - camera verbs and motion rhythm, the image supplies the subject
Short prompts work in the reference code ('A dog in red hat', 'The bear plays balalaika.') but the templates use long cinematic paragraphs

Camera vocabulary with published control LoRAs (the moves the lineup names): Arc left/right, Dolly in/out, Microwave left/right, Truck left/right; 'controllable camera motion' via those LoRAs - prompt-only camera following is not documented
Structured-length guidance (word counts, shot syntax): NOT FOUND

prompting.structure: tags first (light, shot size, time of day, composition, colour, lens), then one prose paragraph: subject, action, camera motion, atmosphere; English or Russian

hurts.line: relying on a negative prompt on the nocfg / distilled checkpoints (cfg 1 skips it)
a start image whose aspect is far from 768x512: the template center-crops it to 768x512 ('area is close to 768*512')
'Static' and 'walking backwards' are in the publisher's own negative - avoid implying them

pitfalls.cause: wrong DualCLIPLoader type (hunyuan_video_15 or kandinsky5_image instead of kandinsky5)

pitfalls.symptom: channel / shape error at decode or conditioning
pitfalls.cause: the HunyuanVideo 1.5 VAE (32-ch /16) loaded instead of the HunyuanVideo 1.0 VAE (16-ch /8)
width/height not divisible by 128, or length not 241
pitfalls.fix: 768x512 x 241 (or other 128-multiples); 5 s checkpoints stop at 121

pitfalls.cause: shift 5 (template) where the publisher says 10 for I2V
cfg 5 on a nocfg / distilled16steps checkpoint

pitfalls.symptom: visible seam / jump after the first frames in I2V
pitfalls.fix: keep both (recipe); drop only NormalizeVideoLatentStart if the start looks over-corrected (no official guidance)

pitfalls.cause: the template force-scales the image to 768x512 with ImageScale (lanczos, center)
pitfalls.fix: match the start image to a 3:2 frame; output aspect follows the image, area ~768x512

pitfalls.cause: 43.4 GB bf16 single file, no quantised Comfy file
pitfalls.fix: use Lite (Pro recipe pending); community: Pro exceeds 32 GB without CPU offload

pitfalls.symptom: files go in the wrong folders / custom nodes missing
pitfalls.cause: the publisher's older custom-node pipeline (comfyui/ folder, text_encoders/text_encoder, vae/hunyuan_vae) mixed with the native templates
pitfalls.fix: native layout: diffusion_models/, text_encoders/, vae/ as in the Comfy-Org templates; do not mix

pitfalls.cause: ComfyUI compatibility of the kandinskylab lora.safetensors files is NOT FOUND
pitfalls.fix: no recipe; prompt the move in prose
